observations: Rightmost door column visibly numbered25. Five storeys, shortened fifth tier, three sash bays, pale stucco, ground channelling, Ionic projecting porch, first-floor stone balustrade and tall windows with pilasters and central triangular pediment. Square-headed windows at all observed levels. Rich upper cornice and flat parapet hide actual roof planes.

North-facing facade identified from address sequence and mapped street; photo does not establish south original-source entrance or hidden L-shaped wing. Cars obscure street/basement; fine ornament simplified.
